title: DSCH - Dash Spear Cooldown Helper
description: Have you ever noticed that on the server, after a successful charge attack with a spear, you tried to dash immediately, but it didn't work? Well, this mod will tell you when you can dash after a successful charge attack, but you set the timer expiration ti
body:
**Commands**

/dsch vector - Toggles whether the timer progress vector will be drawn near the crosshair
(default ON)

/dsch sound - Toggles whether the beep sound will be played at the beginning and end
(default ON)

/dsch chat - Toggles whether the chat will report that you tried to charge too early while the timer was still running. This will help calibrate the timer
(default OFF)

/dsch cd (value in ms) - Sets the specified time in ms for the timer to run after a successful charge attack. When you enter a value, a hint will appear at the top indicating the current time
(default 890 ms)

**This mod does not have a config file, and all settings will be reset after you restart the game.**
